sdk_language.description: Search this SDK's API reference together with the guides. Accepts an SDK language such as "python" or "typescript", or "http" (default — the language-neutral REST reference); unrecognized values fall back to "http". Results for endpoints then link to that SDK's reference pages and match its method names.

kind.description: Only return results of one kind: "prose_page" (guide pages), "api_sdk_method" (one API method, such as "Create a Message"), or "api_sdk_resource" (a group of endpoints, such as Messages).

name: search_docs
description: Search Claude documentation (the guides and the API reference together) by keyword or phrase. Returns matching pages and API endpoints ranked by relevance, with snippets showing context around matches.

tab.description: Filter to specific tab (e.g., developer-guide, api-reference)

name: get_navigation
description: Get the documentation navigation structure. Returns tabs, groups, and pages organized hierarchically. Useful for browsing available documentation topics.

path.description: Documentation path (e.g., /docs/en/intro or intro) or a result URL from search_docs (e.g., https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/intro). For fuzzy lookup, use search_docs.

sdk_languages.description: Only include code examples in these languages. Without it, pages include the examples in every language and are much longer.

name: get_doc
description: Get the full content of a documentation page. Returns the page title, description, URL, and cleaned markdown content.

name: get_api_endpoint
description: Get detailed information about a specific API endpoint including parameters, request body, and responses.
